question: how healthy is this company?

profitability.reading: The business that remains earns thin and falling operating returns; the headline returns come from divestiture gains and a near-zero equity base, not from operations. On the trailing four quarters, gross margin is {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, operating margin {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} and return on invested capital {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital|pct}. These trailing figures add the last full fiscal year as filed, which still held RUCKUS, to half-years recast without it, so they flatter the remaining Aurora business. The quarter is weaker: gross margin fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the lowest filed quarter, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} in the year-ago quarter on the same recast basis, and operating income turned from {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year.inputs.before} to a loss of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}. Income from continuing operations was positive in the quarter only because a tax benefit exceeded a pretax loss; the trailing effective tax rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} is not a usable rate, so the calculator holds the rate at {tax_rate|pct} for return on invested capital. Net margin of {ratios.profitability.net_margin|pct}, return on assets of {ratios.profitability.return_on_assets|pct} and return on equity of {ratios.profitability.return_on_equity|pct} rest on trailing net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}, mostly gains and tax items in discontinued operations: operating cash flow is only {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income|pct} of that income, and quarter-to-quarter swings in net income are {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness} times those in operating cash flow. Against its own history the trailing operating margin is above the margin of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct} in 2025 and the three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}, but the operating loss in the latest quarter shows the remaining business has not held that improvement.

efficiency.reading: Working capital is turning more slowly in the business that remains. Do not read the trailing measures as levels: days sales outstanding of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}, days of inventory of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}, days payables of {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}, a cash conversion cycle of {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle} days and asset turnover of {ratios.efficiency.asset_turnover} all average today's balances with year-ago balances filed before CCS and RUCKUS left, so they overstate days and understate turnover. The quarterly trend cells are a better guide, with one caveat: the prior quarter's inputs come from the first-quarter report, filed before the RUCKUS recast. Inventory days rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, and receivable days rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. Both are well above the latest annual cells, {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, which were the lowest of five years, though those annual cells set recast year-end balances against a full-year revenue that still held RUCKUS and so understate days. The cash-flow statement confirms the inventory build: inventories absorbed {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} in the first half against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.prior_year_to_date} a year earlier, and management names higher inventory and prepaid balances as the main uses of working capital. Inventory stands at {terms.balances_now.inventory} and receivables at {terms.balances_now.receivables}. The allowance for doubtful accounts is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} of gross receivables, the lowest filed quarter, even though receivables are concentrated in two cable customers. Assets other than cash and plant make up {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of total assets, the highest filed quarter.

liquidity.reading: At the balance-sheet date the company held little cash, but it had assets about to turn into cash. The current ratio is {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio}, but the quick ratio is only {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio}. Cash was {terms.balances_now.cash} against current liabilities of {terms.balances_now.current_liabilities}, down from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash} a year earlier. In the first half the company repaid {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.this_year_to_date} of debt, redeemed its convertible preferred and paid a special distribution, all from divestiture proceeds. The current ratio is lifted by RUCKUS assets held for sale, which turned into cash when the sale to Belden closed at the start of July 2026, after the balance-sheet date. The release's cash-flow columns print two different end-of-period cash figures for the same date, so the balance-sheet figure is the one used here. The revolving facility is undrawn, but its commitments were cut at closing, and availability after letters of credit is limited by a borrowing base on receivables and inventory. The cash runway field is not computed: trailing free cash flow is positive, so there is no burn to divide by. That positive trailing figure leans on the last full fiscal year, whose cash flows still include businesses since sold. On its own, the first half used {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} in operations, and the second quarter used {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}. After the quarter, management declared a further per-share special distribution, guided to a year-end cash balance with no debt, and said it expects a tax refund in 2027 that the notes do not record. Whether liquidity stays comfortable after the August payment rests on that guidance, and no field here can test it.

solvency.reading: Solvency is the strongest part of the picture, and on this axis the company is healthy. Total debt is {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} a year earlier. Net debt is {ratios.solvency.net_debt}, which is net cash. Debt over trailing EBITDA of {ratios.solvency.ebitda} is {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda}, and debt over capital is {ratios.solvency.debt_over_debt_plus_equity}. Nothing falls due inside a year: current debt is {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current}. Liabilities are {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets|pct} of assets, and operating lease liabilities are {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}, down from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability}. Trailing operating cash flow is {ratios.solvency.operating_cash_flow_over_ebitda} times EBITDA. Interest coverage is missing because the record holds no interest-expense row in continuing operations for the last fiscal year; the company now presents all of its past interest in discontinued operations. With no debt outstanding, coverage is not a constraint today, but the quarter's operating result was a loss of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}, so any future borrowing would start with no operating earnings to cover it. Operating cash flow over total debt is missing because total debt is zero. The undrawn revolver is secured by first-priority liens on substantially all assets.

growth.reading: Growth is negative on every comparison that rests on a single basis. Second-quarter revenue fell {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year, with both quarters taken from the recast report. Operating income went from {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year.inputs.before} to {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}, a change of {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct}. Operating cash flow went from {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before} to {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, a change of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}. Net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year, but that rise comes from discontinued operations, not the business. The quarter-over-quarter figures (revenue {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, operating income {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, net income {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct}) set the recast quarter against the first quarter as filed, which still held RUCKUS revenue and the CCS gain, so they mostly measure the divestitures. The trailing-four-quarter rates for revenue, {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, and operating income, {ratios.growth.operating_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, are artifacts: they are measured against a year-earlier base that mixes filings and comes out negative, at {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.revenue} for revenue. Trailing operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. First-half revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.parts.this_year_to_date} was above the prior first half of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.parts.prior_year_to_date}, so the decline is concentrated in the latest quarter. Over the longer record, revenue shrank at {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} a year over three years and {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct} over five, mostly through divestitures. Management names lower pricing, unfavourable mix, lower volume and a shrinking legacy business as the causes of the latest decline.

free_cash_flow.reading: All four free-cash-flow measures are computed; none is missing. Simple free cash flow over the trailing four quarters is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, only {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_over_net_income|pct} of net income. That is below each of the three prior years in the record: {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.free_cash_flow_simple} in 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.free_cash_flow_simple} in 2024 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.free_cash_flow_simple} in 2023. It is positive only because it includes the second half of 2025, when the company still held businesses it has since sold. Each of the two quarters reported so far this year used cash in operations, and the release prints negative free cash flow for the second quarter. Quality-adjusted free cash flow, after share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} and no acquisition spending, is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Free cash flow to the firm, {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}, is inflated by a fall in trade working capital of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}. That fall comes from receivables, inventory and payables leaving with the divested businesses, not from collections, so this measure overstates cash generation. Free cash flow to equity, {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity}, is deeply negative because net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing} was repaid out of divestiture proceeds, which this measure does not count. Capital spending is {earnings_versus_cash.capital_expenditure_over_depreciation_and_amortization} times depreciation and amortization. First-half capital spending fell to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}, partly because the year-ago half included businesses since sold. Share-based compensation equals {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of trailing operating cash flow.

dupont.reading: Return on equity of {ratios.profitability.dupont.product|pct} is carried by the equity multiplier, {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier}, and that multiplier is an artifact. Stockholders' equity moved from {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier.inputs.average_equity.parts.a_year_earlier} a year ago to {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier.inputs.average_equity.parts.now} now, so average equity is only {ratios.profitability.return_on_equity.inputs.average_equity}. The second driver, net margin at {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin|pct}, is just as unrepresentative, because trailing net income is mostly gains and tax items in discontinued operations. Asset turnover, {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover}, is the only factor that describes operations, and it is low. The calculator holds no earlier DuPont split, so no field shows movement. What has moved is the equity base: it crossed from deficit to positive within the averaging window, as divestiture proceeds retired debt and the gains were booked. None of the three factors shows the remaining business earning a high return on equity. Return on invested capital of {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital|pct} is the better read of the operating return.

anomalies.name: Guideposts cut on memory chip pricing and availability
anomalies.name_ko: 메모리 칩 가격과 공급 문제로 가이드포스트 하향
anomalies.what: The chief financial officer called the second quarter generally in line with management's own expectations, but cut the forward guideposts, citing continuing problems with memory chip pricing and availability. The release attributes the year-over-year decline in Aurora results to a strong licence quarter a year earlier, memory chip pricing and stranded costs, while MD&A credits lower input costs as an offset, so the two documents disagree on whether component costs helped or hurt. Gross margin was {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and revenue changed {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year. No consensus or prior guidance figure is in the record, so the shortfall against outside expectations cannot be measured.

anomalies.name: RUCKUS transaction cost estimate withdrawn without replacement
anomalies.name_ko: RUCKUS 매각 거래비용 추정치 삭제, 새 추정치 없음
anomalies.what: The first-quarter report gave an expected amount of transaction expenses and taxes on the RUCKUS sale. This report drops that estimate and says the sale closed after the quarter, subject to adjustments, but gives no updated cost, tax or gain figure. The cash cost of the sale is therefore open, set against quarter-end cash of {terms.balances_now.cash}.

anomalies.name: Operating cash outflow in both quarters reported this year
anomalies.name_ko: 올해 두 분기 연속 영업현금 유출
anomalies.what: Operations used {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} in the first half, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date} a year earlier. The second quarter alone used {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, against an inflow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before} in the year-ago quarter. Management attributes the outflow to working capital, incentive compensation payments and cash taxes. The cash flows include discontinued operations and are not split out, so the remaining business's own cash generation cannot be seen.

anomalies.name: Low cash and quick ratio at quarter end
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 말 현금과 당좌비율이 낮음
anomalies.what: Cash at the balance-sheet date was {terms.balances_now.cash}, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash} a year earlier. The quick ratio was {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio} against current liabilities of {terms.balances_now.current_liabilities}. The current ratio of {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio} rests partly on RUCKUS assets held for sale, which became cash only after the quarter. The only committed backstop at quarter end was what the undrawn revolver had left after letters of credit. The release's cash-flow columns print two different end-of-period cash figures for the same date, and the year-end cash comparative was restated lower in the recast.

anomalies.name: Special distributions return most of the sale proceeds
anomalies.name_ko: 특별배당으로 매각 대금 대부분을 주주에게 환원
anomalies.what: The company paid a special distribution in the second quarter. It recorded a larger total against retained earnings, which includes dividend equivalents on unvested awards that are still owed. After the quarter it declared a further per-share special distribution, payable in August 2026, whose total depends on the share count; {terms.shares_outstanding} shares were outstanding at the cover date. The first half also repaid {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.this_year_to_date} of debt and redeemed the convertible preferred, so the divestiture proceeds are mostly being paid out rather than kept. Management guides to a year-end cash balance with no debt, and quarter-end cash was {terms.balances_now.cash}.

anomalies.name: Revolver commitments cut; availability tied to a borrowing base
anomalies.name_ko: 리볼버 약정 축소, 가용액은 차입기준액에 묶임
anomalies.what: Commitments under the only committed facility were cut when RUCKUS was sold. Availability after letters of credit is set by a borrowing base on eligible receivables and inventory, and lenders hold first-priority liens on substantially all assets. MD&A still describes the facility at its original size. With receivables at {terms.balances_now.receivables} and inventory at {terms.balances_now.inventory}, falling sales would shrink the backstop.

anomalies.name: Working capital absorbing cash: prepaid, inventory, payables
anomalies.name_ko: 선급비용·재고·매입채무에서 운전자본이 현금을 흡수
anomalies.what: Management explains the first-half working-capital increase mainly by higher prepaid expenses and inventory and lower accrued liabilities. On the release balance sheet, prepaid expenses and other current assets jumped from year-end to June, and nothing says what they hold. Payables and accrued liabilities fell over the half-year, absorbing cash, after rising a year earlier. Inventories absorbed {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} and receivables {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.parts.this_year_to_date}. The tax refund management expects in 2027 is not shown as a receivable anywhere in the notes read.

anomalies.name: Lower pricing, unfavourable mix and lower volume
anomalies.name_ko: 가격 하락, 불리한 제품 구성, 물량 감소
anomalies.what: MD&A explains the second-quarter sales decline by unfavourable product mix, lower pricing and lower volume. It explains the Aurora profit decline by the same causes plus higher SG&A, and names lower pricing and mix as headwinds for the half-year too. The release adds that the legacy business shrank, partly offset by Access Technologies, and that sales fell in EMEA and Canada. Revenue changed {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} against the year-ago quarter.

anomalies.name: Memory chip cost and availability named as a risk
anomalies.name_ko: 메모리 칩 원가와 공급 위험 명시
anomalies.what: The forward-looking statements now name memory chips among the key components whose cost and availability could affect customer pricing and delivery timing. The chief financial officer cites memory chip pricing both for the quarter's decline and for cutting the guideposts. Gross margin fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the lowest filed quarter.

anomalies.name: Stranded corporate costs move onto Aurora; transition-service income falls
anomalies.name_ko: 잔존 본사비용이 Aurora로 이전, 전환서비스 수익 감소
anomalies.what: From the third quarter of 2026, corporate costs previously allocated to RUCKUS move onto Aurora, only partly offset by Belden transition-service income. The forward-looking statements name the execution of stranded-cost reductions as a risk. Transition-service income from Amphenol has already fallen far below the year-ago figure, while reverse transition-service costs continue and could grow if services run past the initial period. Second-quarter operating income was already a loss of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}.

anomalies.name: Restructuring charges and reserve rising under a new plan
anomalies.name_ko: 새 구조조정 계획으로 구조조정 비용과 충당금 증가
anomalies.what: Restructuring charges rose against the year-ago quarter, and the restructuring reserve rose from year-end, under a new plan to right-size the cost structure after the CCS sale. Management expects further actions, with charges that could be material. These charges fall on a business whose quarterly operating result was {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}.

anomalies.name: R&D and incentive pay cut while sales and margins fall
anomalies.name_ko: 매출과 마진이 하락하는 가운데 연구개발비와 성과급 축소
anomalies.what: R&D fell in the quarter and the half-year because of lower spending within Aurora: first-half R&D was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date}. Lower variable incentive compensation and lower legal expense also held SG&A down. Without these cuts the operating result would have been weaker. Cutting R&D in a business with falling sales and margins supports near-term earnings at the expense of future products, though the chief executive speaks of possibly investing more aggressively.

anomalies.name: Dependence on one cable customer
anomalies.name_ko: 단일 케이블 고객 의존도
anomalies.what: Comcast took {concentration.facts.38|pct} of second-quarter sales, against {concentration.facts.19|pct} in the year-ago quarter on the same recast basis, and Charter is now named as a major customer too. Comcast alone held {concentration.facts.41|pct} of receivables at the quarter end. After the divestitures, the remaining business depends on a few cable operators. The allowance against those receivables, at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, is the thinnest filed quarter, and no text addresses credit risk on these two counterparties.

anomalies.name: Gross margin at the lowest filed quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 매출총이익률이 기록된 분기 중 최저
anomalies.what: Second-quarter gross margin was {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the lowest of the filed quarters. That compares with {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} in the year-ago quarter on the same recast basis and {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct} in the first quarter as filed. The release's adjusted gross margin series shows the same fall. The latest annual margin, {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, was the highest of five years, so the drop is recent.

anomalies.name: Operating loss in the quarter and thin returns on capital
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 영업적자와 낮은 자본수익률
anomalies.what: Operating income was {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter} in the second quarter, against {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year.inputs.before} a year earlier, and first-half operating income was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income.parts.this_year_to_date}. The release shows Aurora segment operating income and Core adjusted EBITDA both falling steeply. Trailing operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} and return on invested capital of {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital|pct} are thin, even though they include the last full fiscal year, which still held RUCKUS.

anomalies.name: Continuing income rests on tax benefits
anomalies.name_ko: 계속영업이익이 세금 혜택에 의존
anomalies.what: Second-quarter income from continuing operations is positive only because an income tax benefit exceeded a pretax loss. The benefit came mostly from equity compensation and a deferred-tax remeasurement, and the text does not say whether these items recur. For the first half, a tax benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} sits against pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.this_year_to_date}. The last full fiscal year followed the same pattern: a tax benefit far larger than pretax income. The trailing effective rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} is not a usable rate.

anomalies.name: Net income is divestiture gains, not cash from operations
anomalies.name_ko: 순이익은 영업현금이 아닌 매각 이익
anomalies.what: Trailing net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} gives a net margin of {ratios.profitability.net_margin|pct} and return on assets of {ratios.profitability.return_on_assets|pct}, but most of it is gains and tax items in discontinued operations. Operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income|pct} of it, and accruals are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct} of average assets. The latest annual accruals cell, {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, is the highest of five years. Discontinued-operations tax lines carry large benefits and expenses that no paragraph explains. These gains do not come from the business that remains.

anomalies.name: Pretax result leans on interest from cash that is being paid out
anomalies.name_ko: 세전이익이 배당으로 빠져나가는 현금의 이자수익에 의존
anomalies.what: MD&A attributes continuing-operations interest income to interest earned on the CCS sale proceeds, and other income benefited from gains on financial assets it does not identify. The same proceeds funded the special distribution, and a further one is declared, so this support for pretax income shrinks as the cash is paid out. Meanwhile operating income is already a loss of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}, and quarter-end cash was {terms.balances_now.cash}.

anomalies.name: Warranty accrual rising against sales
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 대비 보증충당금 증가
anomalies.what: The warranty accrual is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} of quarterly revenue, the highest of the comparable filed quarters. A year earlier it was {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, with both quarters taken from the same filing. The accrual itself stands at {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual}, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}, while revenue was roughly flat. A larger warranty provision adds cost to a business whose margin is already falling, and the items read give no cause for it.

anomalies.name: Inventory days rising, with cash absorbed by the build
anomalies.name_ko: 재고일수 증가와 재고 확대에 따른 현금 흡수
anomalies.what: Inventory days rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} in the second quarter, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} in the first quarter as filed, against the latest annual cell of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}. Inventory rose on the balance sheet from year-end to June while sales fell, and absorbed {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} of cash in the first half. Management gives no cause for the build. The release names memory chip pricing and availability as a current problem, and the revolver's borrowing base rests partly on this inventory. Some retained inventory serves an Amphenol supply agreement that now shows negative revenue. No inventory reserve is tagged, so how far the inventory is protected against obsolescence cannot be read.

anomalies.name: Receivable days rising, with a thin allowance
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 회수일수 증가와 얇은 대손충당금
anomalies.what: Receivable days rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the first quarter as filed, and receivables over quarterly revenue rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}. The comparison spans the RUCKUS recast, so part of the rise may be a change of scope. The latest annual cell of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} understates days, because it sets recast year-end receivables against revenue that still held RUCKUS. Collections are slower relative to sales and concentrated in two customers, and the allowance, at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} of gross receivables, is the lowest filed quarter.

anomalies.name: Low asset turnover; assets mostly other than cash and plant
anomalies.name_ko: 낮은 자산회전율과 현금·설비 외 자산 비중 확대
anomalies.what: Trailing asset turnover is {ratios.efficiency.asset_turnover} and the trailing cash conversion cycle is {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle} days, both distorted by year-ago balances that still held the divested businesses. On the current balance sheet, assets other than cash and plant are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of total assets, the highest filed quarter, after the special distribution drained cash. The remaining asset base is mostly receivables, inventory, prepaid items, deferred tax assets, intangibles and assets held for sale rather than cash.

anomalies.name: Any future borrowing would have no operating earnings to cover it
anomalies.name_ko: 향후 차입 시 이를 감당할 영업이익이 없음
anomalies.what: With total debt at {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, this is the only solvency-side pressure. Interest coverage is missing because no interest-expense row exists in continuing operations for the last fiscal year. An interest expense line now appears in continuing operations from amortized facility fees, and management expects to incur interest expense in future. The second quarter's operating result was a loss of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}. Any draw on the revolver, which is secured on substantially all assets, would start with no operating earnings to cover its interest.

anomalies.name: Second-quarter revenue below the year-ago quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 이번 분기 매출이 전년 동기보다 감소
anomalies.what: Second-quarter revenue fell {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} against the year-ago quarter on the same recast basis, with declines in EMEA, in Canada and in the legacy business. First-half revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.parts.this_year_to_date} was above the prior first half of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.parts.prior_year_to_date} because of a stronger first quarter, so the decline is concentrated in the latest quarter.

anomalies.name: Operating income and operating cash flow reversed year over year
anomalies.name_ko: 영업이익과 영업현금흐름이 전년 대비 역전
anomalies.what: Operating income changed {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year, from profit to loss. Quarterly operating cash flow changed {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}, from inflow to outflow, and trailing operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Non-GAAP adjusted net income and Core adjusted EBITDA also fell against the year-ago quarter.

anomalies.name: Long-run shrinkage to a single segment
anomalies.name_ko: 장기 축소로 단일 사업부만 남음
anomalies.what: Revenue in the record shrank at {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} a year over three years and {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct} a year over five, mostly through divestitures. After the RUCKUS sale the company has one reportable segment and a narrower customer base. The smaller scale leaves less revenue to absorb the stranded corporate costs now being reallocated.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities shrinking against revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 대비 계약부채 감소
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} of quarterly revenue, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} in the first quarter as filed and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} a year earlier. The balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}, and the latest annual cell was the lowest of five years. Fewer customer prepayments relative to sales is a weaker forward signal, though the earlier balances include businesses since sold, so part of the fall is a change of scope.

path_to_distress.reading: Distress is not near. There is no debt ({ratios.solvency.total_debt}), nothing matures inside a year ({terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current}), and the RUCKUS proceeds arrived after the quarter. The pressure is operating, not financial, and it would become distress only if several of these conditions held together. First, the remaining business keeps using cash: second-quarter operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} and first-half operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} would have to persist into periods that no longer include the divested businesses. That would turn trailing free cash flow, now {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, negative, and a cash runway would then be computed against cash that stood at {terms.balances_now.cash} on the balance-sheet date. Second, the special distributions and any acquisitions the chief executive describes would have to use up the sale proceeds faster than operations replace them. Third, the company would have to start borrowing, moving total debt off zero, while operating income stays a loss ({ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}); interest coverage, which cannot be computed today, would then start below one. Fourth, the revolver's borrowing base, set on receivables ({terms.balances_now.receivables}) and inventory ({terms.balances_now.inventory}), would have to shrink as sales fall, cutting the only committed backstop. Fifth, the business depends on one customer for most of its sales ({concentration.facts.38|pct} of second-quarter sales went to Comcast), so a cut in that customer's orders would hit revenue, receivables and the borrowing base at once. Operating losses would deepen through gross margin, now {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and falling, as stranded costs move onto Aurora from the third quarter of 2026.

summary_ko.profitability: 남은 사업의 수익성은 얇고 악화되고 있습니다. 이번 분기 매출총이익률은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}로 기록된 분기 중 가장 낮고, 영업이익은 {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}로 적자로 돌아섰습니다. 순이익률 {ratios.profitability.net_margin|pct}와 높은 자기자본이익률은 사업부 매각 이익과 세금 효과에서 나온 것이고, 투하자본이익률은 {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital|pct}에 그칩니다.
summary_ko.efficiency: 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일, 매출채권 회수일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 직전 분기보다 늘었고, 상반기 재고 증가에 현금 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date}이 묶였습니다. 최근 네 분기 기준 회전율 지표는 매각된 사업의 작년 잔액이 섞여 있어 수준으로 읽으면 안 됩니다.
summary_ko.liquidity: 분기 말 현금은 {terms.balances_now.cash}, 당좌비율은 {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio}로 얇았지만, 분기 직후 RUCKUS 매각 대금이 들어왔습니다. 최근 네 분기 잉여현금흐름이 양수라 현금 소진 기간은 계산되지 않았지만, 올해 두 분기 모두 영업현금흐름은 마이너스였습니다.
summary_ko.solvency: 차입금은 {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, 순부채는 {ratios.solvency.net_debt}로 순현금 상태이고 일 년 안에 만기가 돌아오는 부채도 없어, 지급능력은 이 회사에서 가장 건강한 부분입니다. 이자보상배율은 계속영업 이자비용 기록이 없어 계산되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.growth: 같은 기준으로 비교하면 이번 분기 매출은 전년 동기 대비 {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}, 영업이익은 {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct}, 영업현금흐름은 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} 변해 모두 나빠졌습니다. 직전 분기 대비 성장률과 최근 네 분기 성장률은 RUCKUS 재분류 전후 수치가 섞여 있어 사업의 실제 성장을 보여주지 않습니다.
summary_ko.free_cash_flow: 최근 네 분기 단순 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, 주식보상을 뺀 품질조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}이며, 네 가지 척도가 모두 계산되어 빠진 것은 없습니다. 기업잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}은 매각된 사업의 운전자본이 빠져나간 효과로 부풀려졌고, 주주잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity}은 매각 대금으로 부채를 갚은 탓에 크게 마이너스입니다.
summary_ko.dupont: 자기자본이익률 {ratios.profitability.dupont.product|pct}는 평균 자기자본이 영에 가까워 커진 자기자본승수 {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier}가 끌어올린 것이고, 순이익률도 매각 이익으로 부풀려져 있습니다. 영업 실적을 보여주는 요소는 총자산회전율 {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover}뿐이며, 그 수준은 낮습니다.
summary_ko.path_to_distress: 부채가 없어 부실은 가깝지 않습니다. 다만 남은 사업의 영업현금 유출이 이어져 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}이 마이너스로 바뀌고, 특별배당과 인수로 매각 대금이 소진되며, 영업적자 {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter} 상태에서 차입을 시작하거나 최대 고객의 주문이 줄어 차입한도가 줄어드는 일이 함께 일어나면 압박이 부실로 바뀔 수 있습니다.

limits: This analysis reads the company's health from its own filed numbers against its own past. It forecasts nothing, and it cannot see what is not in the filings.
